nodes.name: ai-sdk.md
nodes.summary: Vendored Neon plugin reference showing how to deploy a Vercel AI SDK tool-calling agent as a Neon Function against the Neon AI Gateway, including image generation and streaming the response directly to the client.

nodes.name: function-triggers.md
nodes.summary: Vendored Neon plugin reference for Function Triggers: declaring cron/object-storage triggers in neon.ts or the CLI, the delivery payload shape, and the parseTrigger* helpers for Hono and fetch handlers.

nodes.name: mastra-studio.md
nodes.summary: Vendored Neon plugin reference for wiring a Mastra agent (defined against the Neon AI Gateway) to Mastra Studio observability, including structured output and passing credentials via neon.ts.

nodes.name: mcp.md
nodes.summary: Vendored Neon plugin reference for hosting an MCP server on a Neon Function, covering both OAuth (Better Auth MCP plugin) and API-key/session-JWT authentication options plus how to test the server.

nodes.name: sentry.md
nodes.summary: Vendored Neon plugin reference for wiring Sentry error, log, and trace monitoring into a Neon Function, including request spans, deploy-time DSN secrets, and tracing an agent's own calls.

nodes.name: sse.md
nodes.summary: Vendored Neon plugin reference for server-sent events on Neon Functions: a minimal SSE endpoint, a Hono variant, cross-isolate broadcast, the wire format, and a client example with caveats.
